scheduled_maintenances.name: Common Platform Voice Network Maintenance (Sydney, AU - SYD) November 6, 2026 (No Operational Impact)

incident_updates.body:
We will perform scheduled maintenance to our voice infrastructure, including Bring Your Own Carrier (BYOC), Provider Exchange (PEX), and native PSTN carriers during this time. We do not anticipate any service impact. Customers and partners with redundant trunks to both the SYD and MEL datacenter will notice the SYD peer temporarily offline, however all traffic will be automatically rerouted to MEL peer for the duration of the maintenance period.   

This maintenance is on CPL and its PSTN service supporting backend ZP and ZCC in SYD and MEL regions.

scheduled_maintenances.name: Zoom Conference Room Connector DNS Changes in Saudi Arabia Region: November 13, 2026 (No Operational Impact)

incident_updates.body:
As part of ongoing service enhancements for the Cloud Room Connector (CRC) service, Zoom will be updating DNS records for SIP/H.323  and IP endpoints in Saudi Arabia region  .

Effective Date: November 14, 2026

Action Required

To avoid service disruption, we recommend reviewing your CRC endpoint configurations as soon as possible, updating your DNS records and Destination ip with the new entries, and removing the older legacy records before November 14, 2026. 

If you have any questions or issues, please contact Zoom Support.

DNS Record Updates

Saudi Arabia Region

We will update the data-center (DC) domains , along with their respective SRV-Records. An example of the change is as follows:

jed.zmvc.us >> sau.zoomcrc.com

_sip._udp.jed.zmvc.us
